description: Following the annulment of a major member state's election due to AI-generated disinformation, mass protests erupt across several EU cities, demanding stronger regulation of synthetic media and greater transparency in digital governance. The scale and persistence of demonstrations exceed pre-existing models of civil unrest, revealing a deep erosion of trust in electoral integrity. Authorities struggle to contain the narrative, and fringe movements gain traction by framing AI as an existential threat to democracy itself.
